entities.name: Berlin–Szczecin railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Berlin–Szczecin railway, also known in German as the Stettiner Bahn, is a mainline railway connecting the German capital of Berlin with the Polish port city of Szczecin. It is one of the oldest lines in Germany.
